title: 第5章 陈雪娇，玉凝
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
然而，就在陆沉松口气没多久，林天就敲响了他的房门。

    “师弟开门！师伯让你去他那边一趟！”

    林天的师伯，就是陆沉的师尊。

    此话一出，陆沉的冷汗瞬间流了下来，不过他很快就调整好自身，然后给林天开门。

    “怎么了师兄，师尊找我什么事？”

    “你没听说啊，那个合欢宗的妖女说了，咱们玄天宗，有很多那个神秘人的子嗣啊！现在师伯让你过去，很有可能和这个有关！”

    陆沉听到这话，心里“咯噔”一下。

    他强撑着脸上的平静，挤出一个笑：“没听说过啊，这跟我有什么关系？我天天在洞府修炼……”

    林天闻言，也大大咧咧地拍他肩膀：“师弟你紧张啥，我也觉得跟你没关系，走吧走吧，师伯等着呢。”

    两人御剑而起，往玄木峰飞去。

    一路上陆沉脑子里乱成一团，那个妖女到底说了多少？现在师尊叫自己过去，是要当场对质吗？

    “师弟？师弟！”林天的声音把他拉回现实，“你想什么呢？脸色这么难看。”

    “没、没什么。”陆沉抹了把额头的汗，“可能是被封印修为，关了两天，身体虚。”

    林天闻言有些愧疚：“回头我请你吃好的，补补。”

    很快，两人便到玄木峰了。

    飞剑落在峰顶，前方是一座古朴的洞府，门口站着两个值守弟子。

    “陆师兄，师尊在里面等你。”其中一个弟子道。

    “知道了。”

    两人一前一后走进洞府。

    大厅内，一位儒雅的中年男子端坐主位，他正是陆沉的师尊，胡伟。他面容清癯，仙风道骨，此刻正闭目养神，看不出喜怒。

    而在青玄真人旁边，坐着一位女子。

    陆沉只看了一眼，便连忙垂下目光。

    那女子看上去不过三十许人，一袭青衫勾勒出玲珑身段，眉如远山含黛，目若秋水横波。肤如凝脂，唇若点樱，青丝如瀑般垂落腰际，整个人散发着成熟女子特有的风韵。

    偏偏这般绝色，却端坐得端庄典雅，手中捧着一盏茶，神态娴静，自有一股长辈的威严。

    正是师娘，陈雪娇。

    陈雪娇
content_en:
However, not long after Lu Chensong breathed his last, Lin Tian knocked on his door.

"Junior brother, open the door! Senior uncle wants you to go to his side!"

Lin Tian's uncle is Lu Chen's master.

As soon as these words came out, Lu Chen broke out in cold sweat, but he quickly adjusted himself and opened the door for Lin Tian.

"What's wrong, senior brother, what does Master want from me?"

"You haven't heard that the enchantress from the Hehuan Sect said that our Xuantian Sect has many descendants of that mysterious man! Now that my uncle is asking you to go there, it may be related to this!"

When Lu Chen heard this, his heart thumped.

He forced a calm expression on his face and forced out a smile: "I've never heard of it. What does this have to do with me? I practice in the cave every day..."

When Lin Tian heard this, he patted him on the shoulder carelessly: "Junior brother, why are you nervous? I don't think it has anything to do with you. Come on, let's go. Junior brother is waiting."

The two stood up with their swords and flew towards Xuanmu Peak.

Along the way, Lu Chen's mind was in a mess. How much did the witch say?Now that Master has called me over, is he going to confront me on the spot?

"Junior brother? Junior brother!" Lin Tian's voice brought him back to reality, "What are you thinking? You look so ugly."

"No, it's nothing." Lu Chen wiped the sweat from his forehead, "Maybe it's because he was sealed and cultivated, and his body was weak after being locked up for two days."

Lin Tian felt a little guilty when he heard this: "I'll treat you to a good meal later and make up for it."

Soon, the two of them arrived at Xuanmu Peak.

The flying sword landed on the top of the peak. In front of it was a simple cave, with two disciples on duty standing at the door.

"Senior Brother Lu, Master is waiting for you inside." One of the disciples said.

"Got it."

The two of them walked into the cave one after another.

In the hall, an elegant middle-aged man sat at the head of the table. He was Lu Chen's master, Hu Wei.He has a pale face and an immortal spirit. At this moment, he is closing his eyes to rest his mind, and there is no sign of happiness or anger.

Next to Master Qingxuan, there was a woman sitting.

Lu Chen only glanced at it and quickly lowered his gaze.

The woman looked to be no more than thirty years old. She was dressed in a green shirt that outlined her slim figure. Her eyebrows were as dark as distant mountains, and her eyes were like the waves of autumn water.Her skin is like cream, her lips are like cherry blossoms, and her black hair hangs down like a waterfall from her waist. The whole person exudes the unique charm of a mature woman.

She was so beautiful, but she sat upright and elegantly, holding a cup of tea in her hand, her expression was demure, and she had the majesty of an elder.

It was the master’s wife, Chen Xuejiao.

Chen Xuejiao
